company.name: Nebula Security Services
company.shortDescription: Nebula Security Services provides defense, security, medical training, and consulting services for governments, NGOs, and private clients.
company.description: Nebula Security Services operates as a defense and development firm that integrates civilian and military expertise to support public and private organizations. The company provides consulting and program support in areas such as ballistic protection, cybersecurity, anti-corruption initiatives, and public policy. It works with governments, NGOs, and commercial enterprises to align security and development projects with institutional objectives and enterprise capabilities. Nebula Security Services leverages a global network of subject matter experts to design and implement solutions for complex operational and governance challenges. Its offerings include ground instructional training aircraft for realistic airframe-based training, mobile critical care and trauma training for medical personnel, and support for transparency and anti-corruption efforts in conflict-affected and emerging markets. The firm also facilitates access to specialized equipment such as body armor and other security-related products.
